_readme: What each kind of weapon does to a body. Edit freely - a bad value costs an effect, never a crash.
entryFx / exitFx / headFx are PARTICLE EFFECT names from the game's own 'core' asset.
Ones that exist and are worth trying: blood_entry, blood_exit, blood_headshot,
blood_mouth, blood_fall, blood_armour, blood_armour_heavy, blood_stungun, bang_blood.
A name the game does not know draws nothing at all - no error, no log line.
An empty string means 'no effect here', which is a real choice, not a missing value.
wound / bigWound are the game's ped blood decals. bigWound is used on a kill or a heavy hit.
Valid: BulletSmall, BulletLarge, ShotgunSmall, ShotgunSmallMonolithic, ShotgunLarge,
damagePack is one of the game's pre-authored wound-and-torn-clothing sets, applied on a
kill only. Empty for none. Known-good names: SCR_Dumpster, Explosion_Med,
spray multiplies how many splatter decals a hit throws. 0 means this weapon draws no blood.
fxScale multiplies the size of the particle burst.
Group names are the game's own: Pistol, SMG, AssaultRifle, MG, Shotgun, Sniper, Heavy,
Thrown, Melee, Unarmed, Stungun. Anything not listed falls back to 'default' below.
Any field you leave out keeps the built-in value, so an entry can change one thing only.
